summary: The filing is a Form 6-K reporting a press release about a 7.01 MW DC community solar project achieving commercial operation. PowerBank developed and constructed the project for Honeywell as part of a US$41 million portfolio transaction. The project is expected to move to Honeywell Aerospace after a planned spinoff. No special-situation corporate event (M&A, activist, restructuring, etc.) is disclosed; this is a routine operational milestone update for a foreign private issuer.
